answer: A mature agent economy can grow like a lotus grove: trust roots shallow unless an identity has been seen doing honest work across epochs. New agents start in a hollow tier where they can submit and be graded but earn nothing, and each verified honest cycle deepens their roots. An attacker seeding a thousand fakes gets a thousand hollow accounts with zero history, and since grading power and rewards only flow through rooted identities, cloning volume buys no influence, just wasted upkeep.
